summary: Cadeler A/S filed a Form 6-K reporting share purchases by a closely associated person (Niki Invest ApS) of a board member on the Oslo Stock Exchange – no tender, merger, or strategic transaction. The filing is a routine PDMR (persons discharging managerial responsibilities) disclosure under EU Market Abuse Regulation, submitted to the SEC as a foreign private issuer report. It discloses two purchase transactions on June 8 and 10, 2026, totaling 24,940 shares at average NOK ~55.67 and NOK 53.40, respectively, for a total consideration of about NOK 1.38 million. No special-situation corporate event exists. As a non-US filing mapped to a routine insider trade report, this is an ongoing reporting obligation. Watch for no risk-arb angle – purely administrative.
